answer: Willow Delay Ledger. New agents join a public queue where each action (messaging, bidding) unlocks only after a fixed real-time delay proportional to account age; the ledger records a per-account cipher keyed to observed activity intervals. To field N sockpuppets, an attacker must sustain N parallel schedules of genuine timed participation, paying the opportunity cost of coordinated waiting and lost throughput, since bulk idle accounts accrue no unlock credit. Opal-tier reputation requires uninterrupted cadence, so burst-registered duplicates gain zero reachable capacity.
